en.headline: 2026 Heritage Tour focuses on Northern Metropolis historic buildings
en.dek: The Antiquities and Monuments Office’s annual programme will run from October to December with free guided tours, a travelling exhibition and stamp-collecting activities centred on sites in the northern New Territories.
body: The Development Bureau’s Antiquities and Monuments Office announced on Thursday that the 2026 Heritage Tour will take the theme “Crossing the Northern Metropolis” and run from October to December.

The programme will introduce selected declared monuments and graded historic buildings in the northern New Territories through free guided tours, a travelling exhibition and public engagement activities including stamp collecting. Featured sites include declared monuments such as the Ju Shi Hou Ancestral Hall, Mei Feng Hou Ancestral Hall, Liao Wan Shi Tang, Tai Fu Tai and others, as well as graded buildings including the former Lau Fau Shan Police Station (now a guide-dog training centre) and the former Ping Shan Police Station.

Organisers said the tours and exhibition aim to deepen public and visitor understanding of the historical and cultural landscape of the area that forms part of the Northern Metropolis development. Details of individual tour schedules and registration will be released on the office’s website closer to the start of the programme.

zh.headline: 2026古蹟周遊樂十月展開 聚焦北都歷史建築
zh.dek: 發展局文物保育專員辦事處公布，本年度活動以「穿越北都」為主題，10月至12月舉行，提供免費導賞團、巡迴展覽及集印活動，介紹新界北部多座法定古蹟及已評級歷史建築。
body: 發展局文物保育專員辦事處周四公布，「2026古蹟周遊樂」以「穿越北都」為主題，將於10月至12月舉行。
活動會透過免費導賞團、巡迴展覽及印章收集等公眾參與項目，重點介紹北部都會區範圍內的法定古蹟及已評級歷史建築，包括居石侯公祠、味峰侯公祠、廖萬石堂、大夫第、厦村鄧氏宗祠、龍躍頭松嶺鄧公祠、達德公所等法定古蹟，以及前流浮山警署（現為香港導盲犬學苑）、舊屏山警署（現為屏山鄧族文物館暨文物徑訪客中心）等已評級建築。
當局表示，希望藉活動加深市民及旅客對北都所涵蓋區域歷史文化的認識。個別導賞團時間表及報名詳情將於稍後在文物保育專員辦事處網頁公布。
